hero_desc: An elegant, historic jewel in the heart of Flanders, in the north of France.
badge_text: In the Heart of French Flanders
intro_subtitle: A timeless interlude at the rhythm of inland Flanders.
intro_text1: L’Hostellerie Saint-Louis, an 18th-century manor house, is set in a quiet spot in the village of Bollezeele, in the middle of a pretty, tree-lined and flower-filled garden. It lies between tourist towns such as Saint-Omer, Cassel, Bergues and Gravelines. The hotel has 27 rooms, each decorated in a different style, is a member of the Teritoria network, and has a cosy and welcoming atmosphere.
intro_text2: Make the most of your stay to explore the region’s cultural and culinary riches, discover the Flemish landscapes and let yourself be soothed by authentic, warm hospitality.
rooms_desc: Discover refined spaces where modernity and tradition come together to offer you an exceptional break.
resto_desc: Flavourful, delicate cuisine, led by our chef, Cédric Barquant, showcasing the treasures of our region in a warm atmosphere.
news_section_desc: Discover our upcoming events, themed evenings and seasonal menus created by our team.
